m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Aha! The face of the Arcanum's future stands again before the Arbiter Proctis! I knew from our duel that you would be a rising star here.
And you are now eligible to face the Trial of the Understudy, yes? That is the quickest turnaround for an Initiate I have ever seen.
But I am confident you will do well once again. You are familiar with the Trial Chambers. The door to this one is back out in the hallway.
Face the Trial of the Understudy, and if you succeed, you may simply return to Ione. Until next time, my friend.
I suppose I should say "Congratulations." You are now an Arcanum Understudy with the benefits... and the responsibilities that entails.
As an Understudy, you will have a Private Office to decorate and use however you like. You will find the entrance just down the hall.
So the Cabal Agent said we were lying to you? I've spoken no falsehoods, but I haven't told you the entire truth either. I had to be sure first.
We knew the Cabal was watching you, and that you were tainted by Shadow Magic. Actually, we subjected Velma von Venkman to the same scrutiny.
It's true. We know about the Cabal. Its leaders were once in the Arcanum, before the Schism... but Initiates are never privy to this knowledge.
Very well. The time has clearly come. I can say no more until you become an Understudy. Fortunately, your eligibility has already been approved.
To advance to the rank of Arcanum Understudy, you must now speak with Cyrio Cassini and face the appropriate Trial. Then return.
You wish to know the whole truth? Then you must advance beyond the rank of Initiate. Speak to Cyrio and face the Trial of the Understudy.
